$comment: Russian typography as live macOS 27 ru writes it (the reference pile's Finder/AppKit/System Settings strings): «…» primary (Finder «^0»), „…“ nested (the GOST pair), ’ for the rare foreign apostrophe, the single … hugging its word (198 label-ending, zero spaced), a no-break space before % (11 no-break, 3 plain, 0 tight: «100 %») and before the dash — with a space after (all 72 macOS dashes: «Системные настройки — %@»). Hedges: every bracketed or slashed number, case, or gender ending, and a guessed ending on an insert. Grammar is resolved with ICU plural/select or a neutral frame, never a hedge. Rationale: docs/i18n/ru/style.md § Typography. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: a no-break space (U+00A0) goes before % (42 %), as macOS ru writes it
the dash — takes a no-break space (U+00A0) before it (Cmdr — файловый менеджер), as macOS ru writes it
the dash — takes a space after it
Russian quotes hug their text: no space inside «…»

hedges.why: a bracketed number, case, or gender ending (файл(ы), удалил(а)); use ICU plural/select, or restructure
a slashed ending (объект/а, готов/а); use ICU plural/select, or restructure
a slashed pronoun hedging an unknown gender; repeat the type noun (сервер, папка) or rephrase
a case ending glued to a name Cmdr can't know ({name}а); put a type noun before it, quote it, or use a colon slot
